SUBJECT: Power-of-Attorney of Mrs. Martha EHRLICH,
German Jewish Refugee - Request for
Police endorsement of document for purposes
of legalization.

I attach herewith a power-of-attorney made out
by Mrs. Martha EHRLICH, German Jewish refugee, in
favour of Mr. Julius GUGGENHEIM and Mrs. Bona
GUGGENHEIM, both resident in Zurich, Switzerland,
in respect of a lift and its contents belonging to
Mrs. EHRLICH and at present lying in the premises
of Messrs. BANZAS & CO, Schaffhausen, Switzerland.

A translation in English from the original
German is attached hereto.

Mrs. EHRLICH requests that the Police will
endorse the power-of-attorney for purposes of
legalization in order that same may be despatched
to Switzerland where Mr. & Mrs. GUGGENHEIM can
utilize it in a proper manner.

Mrs. EHRLICH has been informed that she will
be informed by this office if and when the requisite
endorsement is made when the document will be
returned to her.

Ja. Piers
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch

事由：玛莎·埃尔利希（Martha EHRLICH）女士，
德籍犹太难民——请求
警方在文件上背书以便进行认证。

兹附上由德籍犹太难民玛莎·埃尔利希（Martha EHRLICH）女士出具的授权委托书一份，受托人为朱利叶斯·古根海姆（Julius GUGGENHEIM）先生和博娜·古根海姆（Bona GUGGENHEIM）女士，二人均居住于瑞士苏黎世，委托事项涉及属于埃尔利希女士所有、目前存放于瑞士沙夫豪森班扎斯公司（Messrs. BANZAS & CO）处的一部电梯及其内容物。

随函附上从德文原件译出的英文译文。

埃尔利希女士请求警方在该授权委托书上背书以便进行认证，从而使该文件能够寄往瑞士，供古根海姆夫妇妥善使用。

已告知埃尔利希女士，一旦完成必要的背书手续，本处将通知她，届时文件将退还给她。

贾·皮尔斯（Ja. Piers）

TRANSLATION FROM GERMAN

POWER-OF-ATTORNEY
------------------

I, Martha EHRLICH, born WORTSMANN, hereby
give my power-of-attorney to 1) Mr. Julius W. GUGGENHEIM
and to 2) Mrs. Bona GUGGENHEIM, both resident at 122
Dufour-Strasse, Zurich (Switzerland),
jointly or separately
to dispose of my lift lying in the premises of the firm
of Messrs. DANZAS & CO., Schaffhausen (Switzerland).
It is hereby pointed out that the persons in
whose favour this power-of-attorney has been issued may
jointly or separately
A. auction the lift in Switzerland and dispose of the
money derived therefrom.
B. open the lift and take note of its contents.
C. despatch the lift to their addresses or that of
a third person.
D. dispose of the lift in any manner.
The persons in whose favour this power-of-
attorney is issued are also allowed to auction, sell or
dispose in any manner of parts of the contents.

Shanghai, February 10, 1942
(signed) Martha EHRLICH

Seen and observed to be in order.

Deputy Commissioner,
Crime and Special Branches.
Shanghai Municipal Police.

March 7, 1942

德文译文

授权委托书
------------------

本人，玛莎·埃尔利希（Martha EHRLICH），婚前姓沃茨曼（WORTSMANN），特此授予 1) 朱利叶斯·W·古根海姆（Julius W. GUGGENHEIM）先生和 2) 博娜·古根海姆（Bona GUGGENHEIM）女士（二人均居住于瑞士苏黎世杜富尔街 122 号）联合或单独处置本人存放于瑞士沙夫豪森丹萨斯公司（Messrs. DANZAS & CO.）处的一部电梯的权力。特此指出，本授权委托书所授予之人可联合或单独执行以下事项：
A. 在瑞士拍卖该电梯并处置所得款项。
B. 打开该电梯并清点其内容物。
C. 将该电梯发运至其地址或第三方地址。
D. 以任何方式处置该电梯。
本授权委托书所授予之人亦被允许拍卖、出售或以任何方式处置部分内容物。

上海，1942年2月10日
（签名）玛莎·埃尔利希（Martha EHRLICH）

经阅核，无误。

副警务处长，
刑事及特务科。
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

1942年3月7日
